thread:
tara_csm: Heads up — Garnet (NZ pilot) needs mTLS egress + a soft QPS bump for a customer demo tomorrow 08:00 NZT. Ask: temporary allowlist + QPS to 1200 for ~4 hours. cc @sam_sre @leo_network

sam_sre: Got it. We need their public NAT CIDRs (private RFC1918 ranges won't be routable upstream). Also: is traffic bursty or sustained? That changes batching/capacity.

tara_csm: They'll confirm public IPs in a minute. From product: mostly short demo bursts, a few long polling calls but <30s each. Also they require header pinning and mTLS client certs.

leo_network: If partner only gives private ranges we can do customer-peering (BGP) but that's 24-48h. For a same-day demo we can add a temporary edge allowlist for their partner NAT IPs. Who signs off on a 72h temp window?

mia_cs: I'm on the call with their partner now — asking for public egress immediately. They also said cert CN will be *.garnet-demo.company. Any restrictions on CN?

ops_bot: FYI auto-allowlist policy: max 72h temporary windows, auto-revoke unless 'permanent' flag set. mTLS cert uploads must be stored in KMS; max cert size 8KB. Created request slot AL-9982. CLI example to add rule:
```
redwood-cli allowlist add --name "garnet-temp" --cidr 198.51.100.45/32 --expires 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z --note "Garnet NZ demo; auto-revoke"
```

sam_sre: I'll wait for the public IPs then apply. Reminder: need to patch edge-proxy NGINX for mTLS verify_client on; I'll canary that change first.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: canary edge-proxy/mTLS-update #3421 -> status: started (ETA ~6m)

tara_csm: Partner replied — public NATs: 198.51.100.45/32 and 198.51.100.46/32. Legal's ok with demo terms. Please proceed.

sam_sre: Adding allowlist now and applying route override for 'garnet-demo' QPS -> 1200 from 2026-03-24T22:00:00Z to 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. Ticket: CS-4578. Will post live link when done.

mia_cs: Perfect — I'll notify the customer and include the rollback plan (we'll revert QPS and revoke allowlist if latency >150ms or error rate >3%). :thumbsup:

ops_bot: Allowlist applied: AL-9982. Rules: 198.51.100.45/32,198.51.100.46/32. Expires 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. QPS override applied to route 'garnet-demo' -> 1200. Auto-revoke scheduled.

sam_sre: Canary passed (no client cert failures); rolling to prod edge in 2m.

tara_csm: Thank you — filing a short renewal note: pilot went smoothly, provisioning was fast — good signal for renewal conversation.

sam_sre: Done. Added note to CS ticket and linked deploy logs. Closing loop here unless someone wants to keep the allowlist beyond auto-revoke window.

tara_csm: We'll re-evaluate after demo. Appreciate the quick turnaround, team. :heart:
